articles.title: Thunderstorm warnings issued for parts of UK with flash flooding expected
articles.description: Warnings for northern England, eastern Scotland and Northern Ireland will come into force later on Wednesday.

articles.title: Israeli army orders criminal investigation into killing of Palestinian girl Hind Rajab in Gaza
articles.description: The five-year-old spent hours on the phone to paramedics before her body was recovered days later in Gaza City in 2024.

articles.title: Jump in energy bills drives UK inflation to highest rate for four months
articles.description: A 2.9% rise in inflation had been widely expected by economists, with Chancellor John Healey saying the Iran war “continues to impact prices here at home”.

articles.title: PM unveils plan to get rough sleepers off streets for Christmas
articles.description: Rough sleepers in England will be offered housing, in a move likened to the “Everyone In” initiative during the pandemic.
